The Topology Boundary Auditor confirmed high mask confidence for the figs, suggesting the main subjects are well-defined and not melting into the background, despite the background's own geometric quirks. The severity ratings are appropriate; these are minor distractions that do not break the illusion of the primary subject (the figs).

artifact_reasoning: While the primary subjects (figs) are structurally sound (high topology mask confidence), the background elements show signs of AI generation.
